source.extractionNote: One set (2 variants) and the full 'Navigation Drawer Metadata' frame. Its parts are the Navigation Rail family's own sets, specified in specs/navigation-rail and specs/sub-menu-item.

summary: The app's destinations in a tall panel at the edge of the screen, opened from a menu button. Modal slides over the page on a Scrim and closes on Escape, a scrim click, the header's close button or a chosen destination. Standard sits in the layout beside the content and pushes it. Built from the Navigation Rail family with no new parts.

intent.true: Slides over the page on a Scrim, traps focus and closes on dismissal or a chosen destination.
intent.false: Standard: sits in the layout beside the content and pushes it. Closed, it narrows to nothing. The trigger lives on the main page content

intent.true: Shows a full-width primary Button under the header, for a create or compose entry point.
intent.false: Hides it, for a drawer that is purely navigational.

menuSlot.prefers: Sub Menu Item (specs/sub-menu-item), Collapsible Menu Item (specs/navigation-rail), Divider (specs/divider)

footerSlot.prefers: Sub Menu Item (specs/sub-menu-item), Collapsible Menu Item (specs/navigation-rail), Divider (specs/divider)

intent.start: Code only. Comes from the leading edge (Left).

intent.rounded: Code only. Rounds the rows, groups and buttons inside (radius/sm). The drawer itself is never rounded.

intent.true: Code only. Escape and a scrim click close a modal drawer.
intent.false: Only the close button or a destination closes it.

intent.true: Code only. Choosing a destination closes a modal drawer. Opening a group never does.
intent.false: The drawer stays open after a destination is chosen.

intent.length: The project sets its own width. A modal drawer always leaves control/lg of page visible.

intent.true: Set on the exposed Navigation Header (Show Icon Button). Its icon button shows the close glyph and closes the drawer.
intent.false: No close button. Escape, a scrim click or a destination still closes a modal drawer.

contentInputs.sample: Home (selected, home), Inbox (badge 2, inbox), Schedule (calendar), Documents group (folder), Divider, Reports group (chart-bar), Team group (group)

anatomy.role: surface/overlay with Shadow/large when modal, surface/section when standard. No corner radius.
The Navigation Header and the optional action. Sticky at the top; the only frozen part.
The Menu Slot. Takes the free height when content is short and never scrolls on its own.
The Footer Slot, straight after the menu. Scrolls with it; not pinned.

dependencies.name: Scrim
dependencies.note: The modal drawer's backdrop. Not inside the set.

effect: Shadow/large (shadow/large/x, shadow/large/y, shadow/large/blur, shadow/soft; shadow/small/x, shadow/small/y, shadow/small/blur, shadow/hard)

states.trigger: Menu button, or open set from outside
states.whatChanges: Slides in from its edge while the Scrim fades in. Focus moves to the first control inside.

states.trigger: Escape, scrim click, close button or a chosen destination
states.whatChanges: Slides back out and the Scrim fades. Focus returns to the menu button.

states.trigger: open set from outside, usually a menu button beside the content
states.whatChanges: Widens from nothing and pushes the content. Closed, it is inert.
The group's rows show or hide and its caret turns. The drawer stays open.
Opens and closes with no slide, fade or width change.

behavior.description: Modal slides from its edge and the Scrim fades; standard widens. All use animations/smooth, and none run under reduced motion.
Escape, a scrim click, the close button or a chosen destination close a modal drawer. Dismissible=false ignores Escape and the scrim.
Modal traps focus, starts on the first control and returns to the menu button on close. The page behind is inert and does not scroll.
Only the header is frozen; it sticks to the top. The menu never scrolls on its own and the footer is never pinned. Standard scrolls with the page; modal scrolls as one surface with no scrollbar.
When content is short the menu takes the free height, so the footer sits at the bottom. Figma draws a fixed 800px.
Follows the page's mode. Unlike Navigation Rail, it is not locked to dark.

content.type: slot, preferred only: Sub Menu Item, Collapsible Menu Item, Divider
content.description: The destinations. Top-level rows are Sub Menu Items so glyphs and labels line up; groups are Collapsible Menu Items; a Divider separates sections.

content.type: slot, preferred only: Sub Menu Item, Collapsible Menu Item, Divider
content.description: Destinations after the menu, such as Settings and Help. It scrolls with the menu; it is not pinned.
The top of the drawer: logo or avatar and title. Its icon button is the close button; where there is no separate close control.
Primary, large, full width. A create or compose entry point, not a destination; pressing it does not close the drawer.

do: Use Sub Menu Item for every top-level destination and Collapsible Menu Item for groups, so every row lines up.
Use modal on small screens or when navigation is occasional. Use standard beside the content on wide layouts.
dont: Don't use Navigation Rail Item in the drawer. The drawer has no collapsed form, so the rail's square targets don't line up.
Don't pin the footer or give the menu its own scroll. Only the header stays put.

accessibility: The drawer is a nav landmark named by navLabel; modal is also a dialog with that name. Modal traps focus, returns it to the menu button and makes the page behind inert. Escape is the keyboard match for a scrim click. The selected row carries aria-current=page and group headers report aria-expanded. Every icon-only control, the close button included, needs an accessible name.

layoutTheming.description: 320px, a literal: no width token exists. Never wider than the viewport less control/lg.
Fills the viewport (modal) or at least its row (standard) and grows with its content. Figma draws 800px.
space/card top and bottom, space/md left and right.
space/md between header, action, menu and footer; space/2xs between rows.
No radius on the drawer in either shape. Shape only rounds what is inside.
Modal: Shadow/large over the Scrim (overlay/scrim). Standard: none.
surface/overlay when modal, surface/section when standard.
The drawer binds only its surface. Rows, header and button bring their own tokens and follow any mode or brand extension.

issues.detail: The panel's width is a raw 320Px with no token. The metadata says so; implement it as one named literal.
Show Close is not a set property. It is the exposed Navigation Header's Show Icon Button, with its glyph swapped to close. Code exposes it as one drawer prop.
Side, Shape, Dismissible, Close On Navigate and Width are code only; Figma draws start, rounded and 320Px.
Menu Slot and Footer Slot are listed under Content & Slot, not the Property Breakdown.
Motion, the sticky header and the Scrim backdrop are not drawn in the set; States, Behavior and Layout & Theming describe them.
